source: The lengths are golfisverige.com's card for Upsala GK Mellanbanan, CONFIRMED HOLE BY HOLE against the club's own per-hole banguide (banguider.se): every one of the five tee values on holes 1, 7 and 8 matches exactly, and the pars match on all nine. VERIFIED ARITHMETICALLY too: the nine pars sum to the printed 35, and two independent tee columns reproduce their printed Out totals exactly - Orange 1814 and Vit 2601.
note: Par 35 over nine holes (par 70 played as eighteen, the same nine twice). Five tees. Course by Peter Nordwall, in play 2001; the club calls hole 8 its signature, played from a tee looking out over the Stora banan. THE STROKE INDEX CAME FROM THE CLUB, NOT FROM THE AGGREGATOR: golfisverige.com publishes a different index column (13,9,3,15,11,1,17,5,7) which is a valid odd 1-17 permutation and therefore passes every arithmetic check, but disagrees with the club's own banguide on ALL NINE holes. The club prints an Index n/n+1 per hole - front nine odd, back nine even - and those are the values used here: hole 8 is Index 1/2, the hardest, which is also the hole the club calls its signature. Upsala GK has three courses: Stora banan (18, this repo's 'upsala'), Mellanbanan (this card) and a Lilla pay-and-play nine. Mellanbanan is not mapped in OpenStreetMap; its geometry is registered from the club banguide.
indexSource: banguider.se per-hole sheets for Upsala GK Mellanbanan, read from the Index box on each of the nine
